name: ToDesk
description: A fast-growing Chinese remote-access platform (founded 2020, Haikou) built around a proprietary low-latency ZeroSync engine and OTT SD-WAN routing — claims sub-40ms typical latency (as low as ~3ms in ideal conditions), with editions specifically tuned for gaming, design, and high-frame-rate use, on top of 150M+ installs.

Multi-Monitor Support.comment: Flexible multi-monitor / split-screen display, emphasized in the Performance edition

Adaptive Bitrate.comment: OTT SD-WAN intelligent bandwidth control, claimed to stay usable at up to ~30% packet loss

H.264 Codec.comment: Uses a proprietary "ToDesk Codec"; not confirmed whether it's H.264-based under the hood

Frame Rate (FPS).comment: Base tiers target smooth 4K; the Performance edition markets up to 8K resolution and 360 FPS

Session Recording.comment: Cloud-encrypted session recording for archiving/security audits, emphasized on the Enterprise edition

Pre-Login Access.comment: Positioned for unattended business remote access, though not explicitly confirmed with a direct source

No Account Required.comment: Ad-hoc one-time connections are possible, but persistent unattended access and the File Center feature require an account

Linux X11: Host.comment: Official .deb/.rpm packages and an AUR build are available

Android: Host.comment: Controlling an Android device is offered as a specialized paid add-on, not a default capability

Web Browser: Client.comment: No official browser-based client found; native apps only

NVIDIA RTX 4090.comment: GPU tier is marketed as relevant (Gaming/Performance editions target 4K/8K/360fps), but no published comparative benchmark table exists

Free Tier.comment: Personal Free Edition, marketed as free with unlimited connection speed

Personal: Monthly.comment: Professional/Gaming/Design editions exist; exact published USD pricing wasn't found in English-language sources

Team / Business: Monthly.comment: Performance edition targets demanding professional/creative use cases

Enterprise.comment: Adds centralized device/account management, batch deployment, granular permissions, and session recording for audits
